newsitem.title: USA: Enova, Sears form energy alliance.
newsitem.headline: Enova, Sears form energy alliance.

text.p: Enova Energy, the energy services subsidiary of San Diego-based Enova Corp, said Tuesday is has been selected by Sears, Roebuck and Co as its partner for a regional energy alliance.

The partnership calls for Enova to assist in the design and installation of a new techical center at Sears' Tucson, Ariz., department store, which aims to be a model for a nationwide system of energy-efficient stores.
Enova will also provide energy services at other Sears facilities in several western U.S. states, helping to improve energy efficiency and reduce costs.
Enova Energy said it is one of eight regional energy service companies Sears has selected from hundreds of energy service companies across the country.
Enova Corp, which is also the parent company of San Diego Gas & Electric Co, announced in October plans to merge with neighboring Pacific Enterprises, the parent of Southern California Gas Co.
